Reference

Error handling

Decode Solidity reverts and handle RPC, receipt, and event errors.

Error or symptomWhat the caller can do
SolidityBridgeError.wrongChainVerify the configured chain ID and endpoint.
Unknown, overloaded, or malformed ABI functionCheck the ABI and use one of its canonical functionSignatures.
ContractRevertUse signature and arguments for a user-facing error. A generated binding can decode a known custom error.
RPCErrorInspect code, message, and optional revertData. Providers can return different error shapes.
TransactionBroadcastErrorPreserve hash and inspect underlyingError. Check the hash before deciding whether to submit again because the node may have accepted the signed transaction.
WalletError.transactionRevertedInspect the receipt using its hash. A mined revert from execute reports the hash. It does not supply the original Solidity revert arguments.
ReceiptWaitError.timedOutRetain the hash and resume checking later.
EventQueryError.reorganizationDetectedReconcile state from a known canonical checkpoint and restart the watcher.

Recognized reverts include Error(string), Panic(uint256), and custom errors declared by the ABI when the RPC response includes a decodable payload. For a view or simulation, catch ContractRevert directly:

Swift
do {
    _ = try await contract.simulate("set(uint256)", arguments: [.uint(UInt256(101))])
} catch let revert as ContractRevert {
    if let error = try CounterBinding.TooHighError.decode(revert) {
        print("Rejected value", error.attempted)
    } else {
        throw revert
    }
}
